title: RecPulse
description: This mod adds a realistic bodycam effect, camera shake, a bodycam lens, a flashlight, as well as a realistic lidar system. The mod was created as an add-on to the mod (its name will be here after its release), but it can also be used in regular gameplay :D
body: Immerse yourself in a completely new visual experience. The **RecPulse** mod is being developed specifically for our _upcoming horror mod_ to recreate a truly terrifying atmosphere. It brings the aesthetics of realistic bodycam projects straight into the game, drastically changing how you perceive gameplay. _**It features a stylized lens effect, a dynamic camera, a realistic flashlight, and a Lidar system.**_ ___ ### **Features:** - **Bodycam Effect**: Realistic distortion and a chest-mounted camera interface. - **Camera Shake**: Dynamic camera movements that add weight and tension to your every step. - **Tactical Flashlight**: A fully functional directional light source for exploring the darkest corners. - **Realistic Lidar**: Advanced mechanics for scanning your environment in real-time. ___ **Keybinds for using the _Flashlight_ or the _Lidar_ system:** - _Flashlight_ - **"F" key** - _Lidar_ - **"L" key** ___ **The mod also adds 4 commands:** - **/bodycam_on** - turn on the bodycam effect - **/bodycam_off** - turn off the bodycam effect - **/glitch_effect_on {player_name}** - play a glitch effect on the player's screen for 5 sec - **/glitch_effect_off {player_name}** - remove the glitch effect from the player's screen ___ Initially, this project was created as a key add-on for _our horror mod [The mod's name will appear here after its release]_, but it is completely standalone! You can easily use it in your regular survival world or add it to any of your modpacks for an instant atmosphere upgrade. :D **Redistribution of this mod to other platforms without the owner's permission is prohibited!** > **Currently, RecPulse is a Modrinth-exclusive mod.** > **Please report any bugs you find to our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/WeQUfFSdqH).** When adding **RecPulse** to your modpack, please do not forget to include the mod's name and author in the credits section. > **This project uses [Veil](https://modrinth.com/mod/veil).** Do not use **Sodium** or **Iris**. In the current version of the mod, they are buggy and do not always work correctly, but I plan to adapt the mod for them in the future so you can use your own shaders. **There will be no link to the open-source GitHub repository for now, until the release of the main horror mod.** **_This mod is currently in beta testing prior to the release of the main horror mod and may contain many bugs!_** © Frize TV, 2026
